messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Error with building packages when deploying app
parts:
Jin Rou,

The issue here is a known limitation of the ShinyApps platform. The rjags package requires the jags library to be installed on the system. The package fails to build because the jags library is not found. ShinyApps doesn't currently support installing OS packages, however we are planning on supporting this in the future. We've taken care to install a number of frequently used OS packages, but jags is not one of them. If there is enough interest, we can add it as part of the standard installed packages. 

-Andy

On Thursday, November 28, 2013 10:10:34 AM UTC+8, Andy Kipp wrote:
Jin Rou,

The issue here is a known limitation of the ShinyApps platform. The rjags package requires the jags library to be installed on the system. The package fails to build because the jags library is not found. ShinyApps doesn't currently support installing OS packages, however we are planning on supporting this in the future. We've taken care to install a number of frequently used OS packages, but jags is not one of them. If there is enough interest, we can add it as part of the standard installed packages. 

-Andy
